summary: The South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control (SCDHEC) responded to the Draft Environmental Impact Statement and is listed among the agencies that commented. The agency issued a Water Quality Certificate under Section 401 of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act Amendments of 1972, and additional NPDES and sewage facility permits are required from SCDHEC at various construction and operational stages. The agency's role is primarily regulatory — conditioning project approval on compliance with water quality and discharge requirements — rather than expressing outright support or opposition.
